caption:
what a good app does on the night nothing synced

#wearabletech #routine #fitnessapp

slides.bg: a phone and a small fitness ring left on a wooden nightstand in a dark bedroom, a dim lamp behind them, deep shadow all around, still-life photograph, the room is empty, nobody is present, no person, no hands
slides.text:
The night the ring
didn't charge

No sleep data.
No score. Nothing to read.

Most apps go blank
and wait for you

This one asks one question

How long, roughly?

And the day still
gets a plan

slides.heading: A plan that survives a flat battery
slides.body: SOMA uses what it has — and asks for the rest in one tap instead of giving you an empty screen
